create.name: Floating Zendo
create.bio:
Floating Zendo is a lay Soto Zen sangha in San José, California, at the southern end of the San Francisco Bay. It has practised since 1999 under its founding teacher, Angie Boissevain Sensei, a student of Kobun Chino Otogawa who helped him establish Jikoji retreat centre in the Santa Cruz Mountains. The name reflects that the group has never had a zendo of its own and has met in borrowed rooms; today its in-person sittings are held at the San José Friends Meeting House. Since Angie stepped back from a fixed teaching schedule in 2019, her Dharma heirs Carolyn Dille and John Lowney have carried the teaching alongside other senior students.

The main weekly gathering is online on Tuesday evenings: half an hour of zazen, a short service, then a talk and discussion, with speakers rotating through the month and a recorded talk by Kobun or Angie on some weeks. Once a month the sangha meets in person for a Saturday morning of sitting, walking meditation and a short talk, and it also gathers for longer sittings and an annual sesshin, usually at Jikoji, with silent practice, oryoki meals and talks. Members can learn to sew a rakusu, and recordings of Angie's talks are free to download.

courses.title: Tuesday Evening Zen Practice (Online)
courses.description: A weekly Zoom gathering on Tuesday evenings with silent zazen, a short Soto Zen service and a Dharma talk with discussion. Talks rotate among the sangha's teachers through the month. Beginners are welcome and can ask for individual instruction.

courses.title: Saturday Zen Practice in San José
courses.description: A monthly in-person morning at the San José Friends Meeting House, usually on the fourth Saturday, with several periods of sitting and walking meditation, a service and a short talk. Some Saturdays run as full days with lunch and an afternoon talk.

courses.title: Sesshin
courses.description: The sangha's week-long silent retreat, usually held at Jikoji Zen Center near Los Gatos, with long periods of zazen, work practice, oryoki meals and afternoon talks. Participants may attend for a day or two if they cannot stay the whole week.

free_resources.title: Floating Zendo Dharma Talks
free_resources.description: Audio recordings of talks by founding teacher Angie Boissevain, shared under a Creative Commons licence and free to listen to or download.
